Match the following $\int f(x) dx$ is equal to, if
Column-IColumn-II
(A) \displaystyle f(x) = $\frac{1}{(x^2 + 1)\sqrt{x^2 + 2}}$(P) \displaystyle $\frac{x^5}{5(1 - x^4)^{5/2}} +$C
(B) \displaystyle f(x) = $\frac{1}{(x + 2)\sqrt{x^2 + 6x + 7}}$(Q) \displaystyle \sin^{-1} \left( \frac{x + 1}{(x + 2)\sqrt{2}} \right) +$C
(C) \displaystyle f(x) = $\frac{x^4 + x^8}{(1 - x^4)^{7/2}}$(R) \displaystyle ($\sqrt{x} -$2)$\sqrt{1 - x} + \cos^{-1}\sqrt{x} +$C
(D) \displaystyle f(x) = $\sqrt{\frac{1 - \sqrt{x}}{1 + \sqrt{x}}}$(S) \displaystyle -\tan^{-1} $\sqrt{1 + \frac{2}{x^2}} +$C
(T) \displaystyle $\frac{x^6}{6(1 - x^4)^{5/2}} +$C
$
